units.source_text: 不久到达了离夕颜家不远的一所宅院[\[19\]](#part1333.html#m19)门前，

en.t: Before long, they arrived at the gate of a residence not far from Yugao's house,
and had the caretaker open the gate.

units.source_text: 但见三径就荒，蔓草过肩，古木阴森，幽暗不可名状。

en.t: They saw that the paths had fallen into ruin, trailing vines rose above their shoulders, ancient trees stood dark and gloomy, and the dimness was beyond description.

units.source_text: 朝雾弥漫，侵入车帘，衣袂为之润湿。

en.t: Morning mist spread everywhere, seeped through the carriage curtains, and dampened their sleeves.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对夕颜说：“我从未有过此种经验，

en.t: Prince Genji said to Yugao, "I have never had an experience like this before,
and this scene truly chills the heart!
